title: numu CC1pi0 (1 pi0, no pi+-, W_exp<1.8 GeV, theta_mu<20 deg, 1.5<p_mu<20 GeV/c) dsigma/dW_exp [wexp GeV]
motivation: First neutral-pion measurement in the corpus. CC single-pi0 (W_exp<1.8 GeV, no charged pions) is a mixed-isospin channel: Delta(1232) (I=3/2) gives p pi+ : p pi0 : n pi+ = 9:2:1, while N(1440)/N(1520)/N(1535) and non-resonant I=1/2 strength enhance pi0 relative to pi+. It has no coherent contribution and is fed by pi+ -> pi0 charge exchange. Compared with the CC1pi+ samples (norm 0.68-0.80, W_exp<1.4) in the same muon phase space, its normalisation and its W_exp distribution across 1.0-1.8 GeV separate a too-weak Delta (C5A/MA_Delta) from missing higher-resonance/non-resonant strength and from coherent production.
